name: Offsuit Pair
source:
In the mid-1920's, two women take a train ride to Chicago while they try to repair their relationship over a game of poker. As layers of bluffs unfold, it becomes clear that the game is more than what it first appears to be.

[From [url=https://hamaonoverdrive.itch.io/offsuit-pair]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1920年代中期，两名女性乘坐火车前往芝加哥，并试图通过玩扑克来修复彼此的关系。随着层层虚张声势的展开，我们会发现游戏的内涵远比最初看上去的要复杂得多。

[来自[url=https://hamaonoverdrive.itch.io/offsuit-pair]Itch.io[/url]]
